newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria natbank sets repo, leaves key rates steady.
newsitem.headline: Austria natbank sets repo, leaves key rates steady.

text.p: The Austrian National Bank said on Thursday it was calling for bids on one-week securities repurchase agreements at an unchanged and fixed 3.0 percent, adding it was leaving its key interest rates steady.
Bids must be in by 1300 GMT on Friday.
Last week, the central bank allotted 14.62 billion schillings, or 16 percent of bids, in repos.
Austria's discount rate remains at 2.5 percent, the Lombard rate at 4.75 percent and the Gomex money market at 3.4 percent. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 253
